note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (house rules of an imaginary building, jurisdiction unspecified). Relationships, their kinds, the traversal order and the route state are SUPPLIED by the author; the scene draws only those links and never decides whether a rule or an exception applies.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Five supplied links (relations without arrowheads, sequences with them); the tracer visits fact → magnifier → condition → switch → exception; the supplied state opens the branch.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fact without the condition marker and the main-route state supplied. The traversal ends on the main track, the focus is the condition socket, the switch blade never moves and the main track lights instead of the siding; one link is supplied as a communication.
